author: GayPornHub
body:
Hello moderators and administrators of Avicus.net. Im Jb_Guitar and Im currently in my last year of high school (17 years old) here in New Zealand and I'm quitting minecraft next year when I get to university. Times have been quite busy and full on with everything and I'm just looking for something to relax me and thats when I remembered how much fun I had on avicus. I believe I was permanently banned in 2014 for disrespect which was fair, I was a little idiot back then! And then there was a little bit of a sticky situation regarding my other account "JaeboSlice" Its been well over a year since I've played mine craft and I'm hoping to get back on here and have some fun.. At least my ban wasn't for hacks or anything like that, just pure immaturity which I've come out of. Hopefully you lads can understand and we can all have some fun back on avicus :D 

Cheers

-Jb_Guitar
